name: unitree_r1_a5
notes: Hardware-backed: this contract is the one the physical Unitree R1 A5 is driven with. Blueprints and the deploy gate live in PoRobotTrain; this folder is the portable twin. Any brain exported here must pass pocontract verify + the PoRobotTrain gate before it is copied on. Earth and timing verified: gravity [0,0,-9.81], SI metres/radians, 5 ms implicitfast, 50 Hz policy. KNOWN GAPS vs the physical A5 (from PoRobotTrain/docs/level2_walk.md and configs/sim_calibration.yaml, tracked in this folder's README): twin mass 30.15 kg vs real 28.93 kg (1.2 kg extra above the pelvis); contacts condim 6 / friction 1.0 vs training condim 3 / 0.6 randomised 0.3-1.6; sim_calibration last_calibrated_at is null and parity_rms_deg is null, so the actuator chain has never been identified against the robot; the twin applies no domain randomisation. Do not treat this contract alone as proof of sim-to-real fidelity.

frame.sim: metres, right-handed, Z-up, creature faces +X at qpos=0

slots.name: joint_pos_rel
slots.rule: q - default, role order, 0 for masked roles

slots.name: joint_vel
slots.rule: qd, role order, 0 for masked roles

slots.name: prev_action
slots.rule: raw policy output, role order, 0 after reset

slots.name: base_ang_vel
slots.rule: free-joint angular velocity, used directly (already body frame)

slots.name: velocity_commands
slots.rule: vx, vy m/s and wz rad/s; ranges live in the policy sidecar

slots.name: role_mask
slots.rule: 1 where this creature has the role, 0 where padded

slots.name: morphology_onehot
slots.rule: one-hot index of this creature in the family registry

action.rule: ctrl = clip(default + a * action_scale, soft_limit_lo, soft_limit_hi); masked roles are PD-held at default

hardware._comment: Physical bus contract for the Unitree R1 A5. Generated from PoRobotTrain/RobotControl/configs/r1_joint_map.yaml, which stays the source of truth.

checks: joint_map_sha256 matches this creature's role map
